comment: A command normally publishes every index under 'indices'. A command whose indices
are a repeating block -- a graphic EQ, ten identical bands of five parameters --
publishes 'indexRule' instead, which states the arithmetic once. The two forms are
equivalent: the generator expands its own rule and checks it against the
enumeration it replaced, so a rule can never describe fewer or different
parameters than the firmware holds.
To address a parameter: indices below bandBaseIndex are listed verbatim in
bandBaseIndices. At bandBaseIndex and above, band and field are given by the two
formulas, the field name comes from fieldOrder, and its published attributes are
fieldTypes + fieldLimit + fieldMetadata, with anything in bandOverrides winning.

keys.indexCount: Total indices this command exposes, banded and unbanded together.
keys.bandCount: Number of repetitions of the block.
keys.bandBaseIndex: First index belonging to the repeating block.
keys.indexRange: Inclusive first-last index of the repeating block.
keys.band: Expression giving the band number of an index, before bandNumberBase.
keys.field: Expression giving the position within fieldOrder.
keys.bandNumberBase: Number of the first band, for naming: 1 means bands are 1..bandCount.
keys.nameTemplate: How a parameter name is built from band number and field name.
keys.bandBaseIndices: Verbatim entries for the indices below bandBaseIndex.
keys.fieldOrder: Position within a band -> field name.
keys.fieldTypes: Field name -> wire type, identical across every band.
keys.fieldLimit: Field name -> {min,max} where the bound is the same in every band.
keys.fieldMetadata: Field name -> default/applied/readOnly/appFacing shared by every band.
keys.bandOverrides: Band number -> field name -> attributes that differ in that band. Absent when every band agrees. Expect it once a tuned EQ ships: per-band f0 and gain defaults differ by design.

addressSpaceSchemaCrc16.algorithm: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE, poly 0x1021, init 0xFFFF, no reflection, no final xor
addressSpaceSchemaCrc16.coverage: Canonical JSON serialization of the generated contract 'categories' block with SYSTEM/0x03 excluded: json.dumps(categories, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8'). SYSTEM/0x03 is excluded because it contains schema_crc16.
